metadata.title: TON 618 | NASA FIRMS VIIRS NOAA-20 Nationwide ADM3 September comparison
metadata.measure: Monthly sums of daily thermal-anomaly pixel-observations inside cadastral polygons (not unique fires)
metadata.confidence_rule: line_number > 0 indicates a detected fire record; 0=low, 1=nominal, 2=high; high included within nominal/high
metadata.data_quality: Near-real-time raster, not science-quality; satellite detection limitations, geolocation uncertainty and cloud interference
metadata.source_geometry: Lebanon Atlas ADM3 corrected Earth Engine asset
notes: Counted detections are pixel-observations; repeated detections across days or adjacent pixels do not equal separate fires.
No detected pixel does not prove no fire occurred: overpass time, cloud cover, algorithm thresholds and other factors matter.
27 cadastral areas have zero sampled spatial pixels. Their counts have been set to null rather than a misleading zero.
An area with fewer than ten sampled spatial pixels is marked limited; fewer than five, very limited.
Sampled spatial pixel count is not a count of cloud-free observations or quality-approved time steps.
FIRMS anomalies cannot be used as building damage, conflict incident counts or direct aid needs.
17 boundary features with unresolved P-code 0 are excluded from coded joins.
